WITH group_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    eventannotm,
    AVG(instownpct) as group_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
baseline_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as baseline_val
  FROM group_avgs
),
above_baseline_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    group_avg,
    group_avg - baseline_val as excess
  FROM group_avgs, baseline_calc
  WHERE group_avg > baseline_val
)
SELECT
  AVG(group_avg) as mean_of_above_baseline,
  AVG(excess) as mean_excess_above_baseline
FROM above_baseline_groups

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in eventannotm are grouped together naturally by GROUP BY, forming their own distinct group (interpreting 'treating a missing timing as its own group')
Groups with all-NULL instownpct values will have a NULL group average, which AVG(group_avg) will exclude from the baseline calculation (consistent with 'ignoring missing values')
'Each timing group counting equally' means the baseline is the arithmetic mean of all group averages with equal weighting, not weighted by group size
